blocks.text: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Giovanni Lopez on Wednesday urged contractors and businessmen not to tempt government officials into engaging in corrupt practices, as the agency continues its efforts to clean up its ranks following the flood control scandal.
